title: Back to brackets goes back one real step
request: When the reader opened a bracket from the playoffs list, the Back to brackets button should go back one real step in the browser history, so the browser Back button has no dead press afterward. A direct link, a deep link, a delete and the error banner keep working. Update the history docs and rows PLAYOFF-43, 44 and 45.

criteria.text: Sequences A, C, D need exactly 1 browser Back press to leave /playoffs with 0 dead presses (real browser, fake data, 390x844 touch); B and E keep their numbers (1; 3 with 0 dead)
criteria.evidence: Real browser, fake data, 390x844 touch, before/history-d-before.txt vs after/history-d-final.txt: browser Back presses to leave /playoffs, dead presses in brackets. A (list, open, Back to brackets): 2 (1 dead) -> 1 (0). C (error banner button): 2 (1) -> 1 (0). D (open and close twice): 3 (2) -> 1 (0). B (straight link): 1 (0) -> 1 (0). E (season change): 3 (0) -> 3 (0). Console errors none (500s in C are the fake failing bracket).

criteria.text: Reload on an open bracket, then Back to brackets: goes back one step and shows the list; a push made from a ?bracket= entry carries no mark (unit test) and still replaces
criteria.evidence: F (open, reload, Back to brackets, browser Back): 2 (1 dead) -> 1 (0); history.state.usr shows fromList true on the bracket entry before and after the reload. I (error-bracket: open A, fail, open B from the list under the banner, after/history-i-final.txt): the B entry has state null, Back to brackets swaps in place, one browser Back returns to the first bracket address. Unit test (actions.test.ts and the real-router file) checks that a push from a ?bracket= address carries no mark and that a marked entry still gets the mark through the season write.

criteria.text: After Back to brackets the list is at its top (PLAYOFF-41 stays true), measured in a short window where the list scrolls; delete of the open bracket still replaces (unit test); the error banner button works (real browser C)
criteria.evidence: G in a 420 px tall window (list scrolled to 333, bracket scrolled to 300): scrollY after Back to brackets is 0 before and 0 after, list shown. H: after Back to brackets, browser Forward re-opens the bracket (fromList kept). Banner button works in C. Delete of the open bracket still replaces: unit test in actions.test.ts (exactly replace true, navigate not called, even when the entry carries the mark). Not seen in a browser: a delete and the admin tab (they need a sign-in); stated in the docs footer.

criteria.text: Unit tests: changed assertions are edited to the exact new calls, none skipped or loosened; typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit, integrity pass at the head commit
criteria.evidence: All six required checks pass at the head code commit 8b6a388: integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit (826 files, 7524 tests; was 825 and 7513). Changed assertions edited to the exact new calls (actions.test.ts open now state fromList; season-from-bracket mirror now replace plus state), none skipped or loosened; the reviewer grepped for skip, only, todo, ts-expect-error and eslint-disable in the diff and found none. New real-router test file (4 cases) fails on four mutations (mirror drops state, push never marks, always marks, close pushes) and on the fifth after the Forward step.

criteria.text: Docs and rows PLAYOFF-41 to 45, PLAYADMIN-38, the-playoffs-page.md (paragraph, interrupt table, footer) say what the code does; links 0 broken; totals stay 1,958 and 116
criteria.evidence: the-playoffs-page.md: the history paragraph, the browser back or forward row, the reload row and the verified footer rewritten; PLAYOFF-43 rewritten (Forward step, iPhone note, list from its top) and PLAYOFF-44 reworded; PLAYOFF-45 left on purpose because sequence E is unchanged; PLAYOFF-41 and 42 and PLAYADMIN-38 still true (scroll 0). Every changed sentence checked by the reviewer against the code and the saved runs. Link check 2704 links, 0 broken. Recount by the README method: 1958 items, 116 suspected-bug rows (unchanged; two rows rewritten, none added or removed).

reviews.summary: Independent plan review: design is sound and the smallest option (mark in history.state, verified in react-router source: a replace with no state wipes the mark, reload keeps it). Blocking: (1) a push made while the list shows over an entry that already has ?bracket= (admin loading, error banner, legacy null bracket) would carry the mark and Back to brackets would land on that bracket entry; fix = mark only when the address has no bracket param. (2) typecheck break: untyped makeAdminData in bracket-view.test.tsx needs closeBracket. (3) two existing assertions (actions.test:149, season-from-bracket.test:154) change on purpose. (4) scroll after a POP is only knowable in a browser; fix after the POP if not 0. Docs list was short: PLAYOFF-41/42, PLAYADMIN-38 added.

Independent reviewer, three rounds, final APPROVE on the head code commit 8b6a388. Round 1 at 1442221: APPROVE; re-ran my browser sequences, 15 test files, typecheck, integrity; mark logic read against react-router source (a replace with no state wipes it; reload keeps it); six suggestions. Taken: a real-router test so a router upgrade cannot break this silently, a misleading code comment (a failed bracket opened from the list IS marked), docs on the press that shows no change after a swap, the legacy-bracket case, what was only read from the code, an iPhone scroll note. Round 2 at 04d935b: APPROVE, but one mutation survived (the marked branch doing a plain replace passed all four real-router cases). Fixed in 8b6a388 with a Forward step; I saw that case fail on the mutation and restored the hook. Round 3 at 8b6a388: APPROVE, forward step real, only a comment line changed in the hook, docs scope exact. Left as stated: iPhone Safari untested (Chromium only); the admin tab, a delete and the admin new-bracket link read from the code and unit tests because they need a sign-in.
